id: 02_Construction Safety Interview Questions Hindi Safety Officer Interview Questions
title: 安全知识问答：施工现场与风险评估
source_doc: course/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/02_Construction Safety Interview Questions Hindi Safety Officer Interview Questions.md
author_source: project/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/02_Construction Safety Interview Questions Hindi Safety Officer Interview Questions/src.py

points.K12: 脚手架搭设的安全措施
points.K16: 梯子伸出上方平台的长度

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着安全帽站在问答台后，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a hard hat, stands behind a quiz podium and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 建筑安全员面试问答，开始！
overlay: 安全知识问答：施工现场与风险评估

shots.scene: 四个图标：问号、脚手架、风险矩阵、铁锹
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a question mark, a scaffold, a colored grid and a shovel. No people.
shots.narration: 先讲基础题，再讲进阶题。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴着安全帽站在工地板房外，手里拿着空白简历
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a hard hat stands outside a construction site office holding a blank resume.
shots.narration: 阿杰要应聘工地的安全员。

shots.scene: 欣欣拍拍阿杰的肩膀，指向问答台
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pats the young male student on the shoulder and points to the quiz podium.
shots.narration: 面试常问的题，我们一起过一遍。

shots.scene: 人、环境、财产三个图标外罩一层盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A person icon, a tree icon and a building icon under one protective shield. No people.
shots.narration: 安全：免于伤人、害环境、损财产。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手碰到金属锐边，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand touching a sharp metal edge, with a yellow warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 危害：可能造成伤害的东西或状况。

shots.scene: 锐边、没护栏的平台、湿滑地面三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a sharp edge, an unguarded work platform and a wet floor with a slip mark. No people.
shots.narration: 比如锐边、无防护平台、湿滑地面。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着骰子图标，旁边一个警示三角
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a dice icon next to a warning triangle icon.
shots.narration: 风险：被危害伤到的可能性。

shots.scene: 手臂打着夹板的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an arm in a splint and a bandaged hand. No people.
shots.narration: 伤害：事故造成的身体损害。

shots.scene: 倒塌的砖堆、损坏的机器、倒地的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a collapsed brick pile, a damaged machine and a fallen person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 事故：不想要、没计划的意外。

shots.scene: 财产、环境、人身三个图标都带红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A building icon, a tree icon and a person icon, each with a red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 会造成财产、环境损失，甚至死亡。

shots.scene: 锤子从脚手架上掉落，落在小人图标旁边
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hammer falling from a scaffold and landing right next to an unharmed person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 未遂事件：锤子掉了没砸到人。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起食指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger with a serious face.
shots.narration: 没造成伤害，但有伤害的可能。

shots.scene: 工地全景：卡车、高处平台、土坑、搬运工人
shots.prompt_en: A wide view of a construction site: a moving truck, a high platform, an open pit and a worker carrying a heavy box.
shots.narration: 建筑工地有哪些常见危害？

shots.scene: 五个图标：卡车、滑倒小人、耳朵、高处平台、搬箱子
shots.prompt_en: Five icons: a truck, a slipping person, an ear with sound waves, a high platform and a person lifting a box. No people.
shots.narration: 移动车辆、滑绊跌、噪声、高处、搬运。

shots.scene: 四个图标：土方坍塌、结构倒塌、石棉板、电闪
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: collapsing soil, a collapsing structure, a cracked fiber cement sheet and a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 土方坍塌、结构倒塌、石棉、电气。

shots.scene: 高度标尺旁一个小人站在平台上
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram standing on a raised platform with a height ruler beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 1.8米以上的作业，就是高处作业。

shots.scene: 移动脚手架，平台上有小人和材料图标
shots.prompt_en: A mobile scaffold with a person pictogram and a stack of materials on its platform. No people.
shots.narration: 脚手架：高处支撑人和材料的临时平台。

shots.scene: 带轮子的移动脚手架图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a mobile scaffold on wheels. No people.
shots.narration: 类型有移动式，也有固定式。

shots.scene: 碗扣式、悬挑式、悬挂式、满堂式四个脚手架图标
shots.prompt_en: Four scaffold icons: a cup joint frame, a cantilever scaffold sticking out from a wall, a hanging scaffold and a dense birdcage scaffold. No people.
shots.narration: 固定式有碗扣、悬挑、悬挂、满堂。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一张写着十的空白卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card with ten small dots on it.
shots.narration: 国外分类有十种，另作介绍。

shots.scene: 损坏的扣件和松软地面上的脚手架图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cracked coupler and a scaffold standing on soft uneven ground. No people.
shots.narration: 危害：构件损坏，地面不平或松软。

shots.scene: 缺少斜撑、人物坠落、护栏缺失、没有梯子四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a scaffold missing braces, a falling person and object, a missing guardrail and a missing ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 拉结斜撑不当，人物坠落，护栏通道不当。

shots.section_title: 脚手架搭设的安全措施
shots.scene: 老李带着工人搭脚手架
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer guides a worker in a hard hat assembling scaffold tubes.
shots.narration: 搭设人员必须有能力。
overlay: 脚手架搭设的安全措施

shots.section_title: 脚手架搭设的安全措施
shots.scene: 完好的钢管、平整坚实的地面图标，各带绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of sound straight steel tubes and firm level ground, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 材料完好合标准，地面平整坚实。

shots.section_title: 脚手架搭设的安全措施
shots.scene: 脚手架拉结到墙上、斜撑和护栏齐全
shots.prompt_en: A scaffold tied to a building wall with diagonal braces, top rail, mid rail, toe board and base plates. No people.
shots.narration: 按需拉结、设斜撑，护栏底座齐全。

shots.scene: 脚手架线图，构件依次高亮
shots.prompt_en: A simple line drawing of a scaffold with parts highlighted one by one: sole board, base plate, ledger, brace and standard. No people.
shots.narration: 构件：垫板、底座、横杆、斜撑、立杆。

shots.scene: 线图继续高亮扣件、脚手板、挡脚板和护栏
shots.prompt_en: The same line drawing highlights the couplers, the planks, the toe board, the mid rail and the top rail. No people.
shots.narration: 扣件、脚手板、挡脚板、中横杆、上横杆。

shots.scene: 护栏侧面图，上横杆旁有高度范围箭头
shots.prompt_en: A side view of a guardrail with a height range arrow beside the top rail. No people.
shots.narration: 上横杆高度：38到45英寸之间。

shots.scene: 梯子靠墙，地面画出角度弧线
shots.prompt_en: A ladder leaning against a wall with an angle arc drawn at its base. No people.
shots.narration: 梯子的安全角度是75度。

shots.section_title: 梯子伸出上方平台的长度
shots.scene: 梯子顶端伸出平台边沿，旁边长度箭头
shots.prompt_en: The top of a ladder extends above the edge of a landing platform, with a length arrow beside the extended part. No people.
shots.narration: 梯子伸出平台至少1米，即3英尺。
overlay: 梯子伸出上方平台的长度

shots.scene: 倒金字塔分五层，从上到下颜色由绿到红
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid divided into five colored layers from green at the top to red at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 风险控制层级：控制风险的体系。

shots.scene: 老李站在移动脚手架上换吊扇叶片
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands on a mobile scaffold reaching up to change a blade on a ceiling fan.
shots.narration: 消除：彻底去掉危害，最有效。

shots.scene: 老李把吊扇拆下来放在地上换叶片
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer kneels on the floor changing the blade of a ceiling fan that has been taken down.
shots.narration: 把风扇拆到地面换叶片。

shots.scene: 坠落图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A falling person icon and a falling object icon, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 人和物坠落的风险就不存在了。

shots.scene: 幽暗的受限空间里一盏灯，旁边火花和可燃气体图标
shots.prompt_en: A dim tunnel-like confined space lit by a work lamp, with a spark icon and a flammable gas cloud icon. No people.
shots.narration: 替代：用更小的危害降低风险。

shots.scene: 高压灯具图标被划掉，换成低压灯具图标
shots.prompt_en: A work lamp icon with a high voltage mark is crossed out and replaced by a lamp icon with a low voltage mark. No people.
shots.narration: 照明从240伏换成24伏。

shots.scene: 火花和火焰图标变小变淡
shots.prompt_en: A spark icon and a flame icon shrink and fade away. No people.
shots.narration: 减少短路打火引发火灾的风险。

shots.scene: 链条传动机构加上防护罩
shots.prompt_en: A chain drive on a machine gets covered by a metal guard, with a stop button beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 工程控制：隔离危害，比如防护罩。

shots.scene: 工人穿连体服、戴安全帽、口罩和安全带
shots.prompt_en: A worker pictogram in coveralls, hard hat, mask and safety harness. No people.
shots.narration: 前四种用过后，才用个人防护。

shots.scene: 小人和危害之间一道屏障
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram on one side and a hazard icon on the other, with a barrier wall between them. No people.
shots.narration: 它最不有效，只在人和危害间挡一下。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰拿着空白评估表站在脚手架前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student hold a blank assessment form in front of a scaffold.
shots.narration: HIRA：辨识危害、评估风险的正式过程。

shots.scene: 无防护脚手架和太阳图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an unguarded scaffold and a blazing sun. No people.
shots.narration: 危害如无防护脚手架、炎热天气。

shots.scene: 骰子乘以伤害图标的算式
shots.prompt_en: An equation made of icons: a dice icon, a multiplication sign and an injury icon. No people.
shots.narration: 风险等于可能性乘以严重度。

shots.scene: 骰子图标和爆炸后果图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A dice icon next to a burst consequence icon. No people.
shots.narration: 可能性是概率，严重度是后果和影响。

shots.scene: 五乘五彩色方格，左下绿色、右上红色
shots.prompt_en: A five by five colored grid board, green at the bottom left, yellow in the middle and red at the top right. No people.
shots.narration: 风险矩阵：计算风险等级的工具。

shots.scene: 绿色方格亮起，旁边一个放大镜
shots.prompt_en: The green squares of the grid light up with a magnifying glass beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 1到6分低风险，可接受，看能否再降。

shots.scene: 黄色方格亮起，旁边一个监督者图标
shots.prompt_en: The yellow squares of the grid light up with a supervisor icon beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 8到12分中风险，有监督和措施才做。

shots.scene: 红色方格亮起，旁边一个停止手势
shots.prompt_en: The red squares of the grid light up with a stop hand icon beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 15到25分高风险，降下来之前不准做。

shots.scene: 两座脚手架：高的有护栏，矮的没护栏
shots.prompt_en: Two scaffolds side by side: a tall one with guardrails and a short one without guardrails. No people.
shots.narration: 算一算：两座脚手架。

shots.scene: 高脚手架旁出现算式卡
shots.prompt_en: A blank formula card appears beside the tall guarded scaffold. No people.
shots.narration: 高的有护栏，可能性2，严重度5。

shots.scene: 黄色方格亮起
shots.prompt_en: A yellow square lights up on the grid board. No people.
shots.narration: 2乘5等于10，中风险。

shots.scene: 矮脚手架旁出现算式卡
shots.prompt_en: A blank formula card appears beside the short unguarded scaffold. No people.
shots.narration: 矮的没护栏，可能性5，严重度3。

shots.scene: 红色方格亮起
shots.prompt_en: A red square lights up on the grid board. No people.
shots.narration: 5乘3等于15，高风险。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着两座脚手架
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points from one scaffold to the other.
shots.narration: 风险等级随地点和作业条件而变。

shots.scene: 空白表格，八个表头格依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: A blank table whose eight header cells light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: HIRA表：序号、危害、后果、现有措施。

shots.scene: 表头后四格亮起
shots.prompt_en: The last four header cells of the blank table light up. No people.
shots.narration: 措施前风险、附加措施、措施后、责任人。

shots.scene: 小研在第一行贴上无护栏脚手架和骨折图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pins an unguarded scaffold icon and a fracture icon onto the first row of a blank table.
shots.narration: 危害：无护栏脚手架；后果：坠落骨折。

shots.scene: 表中贴上培训图标和红色方格
shots.prompt_en: A training icon and a red square are pinned into the next cells of the table. No people.
shots.narration: 现有措施：已培训；措施前5乘3得15。

shots.scene: 表中贴上护栏图标
shots.prompt_en: A guardrail icon is pinned into the additional measures cell of the table. No people.
shots.narration: 附加措施：加装护栏。

shots.scene: 表中贴上绿色方格
shots.prompt_en: A green square is pinned into the post risk cell of the table. No people.
shots.narration: 可能性降到1，严重度仍3，得3低风险。

shots.scene: 老李戴安全帽在表格旁点头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a hard hat nods next to the completed blank table.
shots.narration: 由现场工程师或主管负责落实。

shots.scene: 地面被挖开一个坑，旁边土堆
shots.prompt_en: A pit dug into the ground with a pile of soil beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 挖掘：从地面取土形成的切口或坑。

shots.scene: 铁锹图标和挖掘机图标
shots.prompt_en: A shovel icon and an excavator icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 分人工挖掘和机械挖掘。

shots.scene: 土方坍塌、人员坠坑、坑内积水三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: soil collapsing into a pit, a person falling into a pit and water pooling at the bottom of a pit. No people.
shots.narration: 危害：塌方、坠坑、积水。

shots.scene: 坑壁露出电缆和管道，坑边有卡车，梯子缺失
shots.prompt_en: A pit wall with exposed cables and pipes, a truck near the edge and no ladder for access. No people.
shots.narration: 地下管线、坑边车辆、通道不当。

shots.scene: 支护、台阶、放坡三种坑壁示意
shots.prompt_en: Three cross sections of a trench: braced with shoring, cut in steps and sloped back. No people.
shots.narration: 用支护、台阶、放坡防止坍塌。

shots.scene: 坑边围挡和警示标志
shots.prompt_en: A pit surrounded by barricades with a warning sign on the fence. No people.
shots.narration: 设围挡和警示标志，防止坠落。

shots.scene: 水泵把坑里的水抽出去
shots.prompt_en: A water pump with a hose draining water out of a pit. No people.
shots.narration: 用水泵排水，防止积水。

shots.scene: 老李拿着空白管线图和许可单
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds a blank utility map and a blank permit form next to a marked area on the ground.
shots.narration: 先查地下管线，取得业主开挖许可。

shots.scene: 工人用铁锹小心挖，卡车停在远处
shots.prompt_en: A worker digs carefully with a hand shovel while a truck stays parked far from the pit edge.
shots.narration: 必要时人工挖，按深度土质限车辆。

shots.scene: 又深又窄的长沟示意，深度箭头长于宽度箭头
shots.prompt_en: A long narrow trench cross section with a depth arrow longer than the width arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 沟槽：深度大于宽度的窄挖掘。

shots.scene: 沟槽俯视图旁一个长度箭头
shots.prompt_en: A top view of the trench with a length arrow along it. No people.
shots.narration: 原片说，长度不超过15英尺。

shots.scene: 工人系着安全带悬挂在脚手架旁，不能动
shots.prompt_en: A worker pictogram hangs motionless in a safety harness beside a scaffold. No people.
shots.narration: 悬吊创伤：坠落后挂在安全带上。

shots.scene: 时钟走过15分钟，腿带勒紧
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon showing fifteen minutes passing, next to a harness leg strap tightening. No people.
shots.narration: 15分钟内没人救，腿带越勒越紧。

shots.scene: 腿部血管图标被压住，血流箭头停止
shots.prompt_en: A simple leg icon with a blood vessel squeezed and the flow arrows stopping. No people.
shots.narration: 下肢血流被阻断，会造成严重伤害。

shots.scene: 安全带上的附加带展开成一个踏环
shots.prompt_en: A small extra strap unfolds from a harness pouch into a foot loop. No people.
shots.narration: 缓解带：安全带上的附加带。

shots.scene: 悬挂的小人把脚踩进踏环，血流箭头恢复
shots.prompt_en: A hanging person pictogram steps into the foot loop and the blood flow arrows in the leg start moving again. No people.
shots.narration: 踩住它，减轻腿部血管受压，等救援。

shots.scene: 五段圆环，每段一个图标
shots.prompt_en: A ring divided into five segments, each with an icon: a bin, a shelf, a broom, a checklist and a medal. No people.
shots.narration: 5S：有效的内务管理方法。

shots.scene: 阿杰清走工地上不需要的杂物，再把工具摆整齐
shots.prompt_en: The young male student removes unwanted scrap from a site corner and lines up tools neatly on a rack.
shots.narration: 整理清走杂物，整顿有序摆放。

shots.scene: 小研擦干净设备，墙上贴空白标准卡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes equipment clean next to a blank standard card on the wall.
shots.narration: 清扫保持干净，清洁建立标准。

shots.scene: 王老师给工人上培训课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator gives an awareness talk to workers in hard hats.
shots.narration: 素养：靠意识和培训，长期坚持。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现危害、风险、事故、未遂图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a warning triangle, a dice, a collision and a falling hammer.
shots.narration: 基础概念和工地危害，要分清。

shots.scene: 脚手架、梯子、护栏图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a scaffold, a ladder at an angle and a guardrail. No people.
shots.narration: 1.8米以上算高处，脚手架梯子有要求。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔和彩色风险矩阵
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid icon next to a colored five by five grid icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按层级控制风险，用矩阵算风险等级。

shots.scene: 挖掘坑、安全带缓解带、5S圆环图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a braced pit, a harness with a foot loop and a five segment ring. No people.
shots.narration: 挖掘防坍塌，防悬吊创伤，坚持5S。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰戴着安全帽在工地门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student in hard hats wave goodbye at the construction site gate.
shots.narration: 祝面试顺利，下期还有更多题！
